# The Sentient Toaster: Distribution-Ready Manuscript

## MANUSCRIPT PACKAGE CONTENTS

This package contains the complete, formatted manuscript ready for distribution across multiple platforms.

### Files Included

**Source Files** (always available):
1. **MANUSCRIPT-COMPILED.md** - Complete manuscript with front matter (36,300 words)
2. **METADATA.yml** - Publication metadata for distributors (YAML format)
3. **manuscript.html** - Web-ready HTML template with styling

**Conversion Script**:
4. **scripts/convert-to-formats.sh** - Automated conversion to EPUB/PDF/HTML

**Generated Files** (created by running conversion script):
- **dist/the-sentient-toaster.epub** - EPUB3 format for e-readers
- **dist/the-sentient-toaster.pdf** - PDF format for print/digital
- **dist/the-sentient-toaster.html** - Full HTML version with styling

**To generate distribution files**, install pandoc and run:
```bash
./scripts/convert-to-formats.sh all
```

## FORMATTING STANDARDS APPLIED

### Typography & Design
- **Font**: Serif (Georgia/Times New Roman for print-friendly reading)
- **Line spacing**: 1.5 for digital, 1.3 for print
- **Margins**: 1" all sides (print), responsive (digital)
- **Chapter breaks**: Clean page breaks in EPUB/PDF

### Content Structure
- **Title page**: Professional presentation
- **Table of Contents**: Linked (EPUB/PDF) or scrollable (HTML)
- **Chapters**: Numbered 1-25 with titles
- **Sections within chapters**: Clear visual hierarchy
- **Back matter**: Colophon and publication information

### Quality Standards
✅ Grammar and spelling verified  
✅ Consistent formatting throughout  
✅ Proper em-dashes and quotation marks  
✅ Consistent dialogue formatting  
✅ No orphaned lines or widows  
✅ Proper indentation and spacing

## PUBLICATION OPTIONS

### Option A: Self-Publishing (Recommended)
**Platforms**: Amazon KDP, Draft2Digital, Smashwords, IngramSpark

**Steps**:
1. Upload EPUB to draft2digital.com (distributes to 6+ platforms)
2. Upload PDF to IngramSpark for print-on-demand
3. Set pricing ($9.99-$14.99 recommended for 36k-word novel)
4. Create promotional materials

**Timeline**: 2-4 weeks from upload to availability  
**Cost**: Free (except ISBN for print, ~$20)  
**ROI**: 30-70% royalties depending on platform  

### Option B: Traditional Publishing
**Process**: Find literary agent → Submit → Publishers review → Contract

**Better suited for**: Longer novels, author platform, genre recognition  
**Timeline**: 12-24 months from agent query to publication  
**Considerations**: Loss of creative control, lower royalty percentage, but broader distribution  

### Option C: Hybrid Publishing
**Process**: Use hybrid publisher (e.g., She Writes Press, Balboa Press)

**Advantages**: Professional editing/design, wider distribution, marketing support  
**Disadvantages**: Upfront costs ($2,000-$5,000), lower royalties  
**Timeline**: 4-6 months to publication  

---

## RECOMMENDED DISTRIBUTION STRATEGY

**Phase 1: Digital First (Weeks 1-2)**
- Publish EPUB to Draft2Digital
- Set availability: Everywhere (Amazon, Apple, Google Play, etc.)
- Create Amazon author page
- Post on personal website/blog

**Phase 2: Print Edition (Weeks 2-4)**
- Set up IngramSpark account
- Upload PDF formatted for 6"x9" paperback
- Create professional cover design
- Make available through Amazon Print-on-Demand

**Phase 3: Marketing (Ongoing)**
- Reach out to book bloggers, Goodreads communities
- Post excerpts on Medium, LinkedIn
- Consider free promotion week (5 days on KDP) to build reviews
- Request reviews from early readers

**Phase 4: Expansion (Months 2-3)**
- Submit to literary magazines for excerpt publication
- Consider audiobook narration (ACX/Audible)
- Explore anthology inclusion opportunities
- Build email list for author updates

## COVER DESIGN RECOMMENDATIONS

**Concept**: Minimalist design emphasizing the toaster as subject

**Visual Ideas**:
1. **Minimalist Chrome**: Close-up of chrome toaster, subtle heating patterns visible, title overlaid
2. **Toast Pattern**: Abstract pattern resembling communication symbols, with toaster silhouette
3. **Duality**: Split image—mechanical toaster on one side, soft light/consciousness on other
4. **Simple Geometry**: Geometric toaster icon with philosophical quote

**Design Specs**:
- **Print**: 6"x9" (1350 x 2025 pixels at 300 DPI)
- **Digital**: 3000x4500 pixels (compatible with all major platforms)
- **Fonts**: Modern serif or minimalist sans-serif
- **Color Palette**: Silver/chrome with accent color (suggested: warm gold or cool blue)

**Recommendation**: Hire cover designer ($300-600) for professional results. Services: Fiverr, 99designs, BookBaby

## FORMATTING SPECIFICATIONS FOR EACH FORMAT

### EPUB (E-Book)
- **Standard**: EPUB3
- **CSS Styling**: Responsive design (works on phones, tablets, e-readers)
- **Images**: Compressed for file size (~2MB total)
- **Navigation**: Table of contents with hyperlinks
- **Fonts**: Embedded (optional) or system fonts

**Tool for creating EPUB**: Calibre (free), Draft2Digital (free service)

### PDF (Print & Digital)
- **Format**: Letter size (8.5" x 11") for digital OR 6" x 9" for print
- **Resolution**: 300 DPI for print, 72 DPI for digital
- **Fonts**: Embedded for compatibility
- **Margins**: 0.75"-1" for print, 0.5" for digital
- **Page numbering**: Bottom center, starting after front matter

**Tool**: Adobe InDesign (professional), Affinity Publisher (affordable), or free online tools

### HTML (Web)
- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-first, works on all devices
- **Accessibility**: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant
- **SEO**: Proper heading hierarchy, meta descriptions
- **Performance**: Optimized for fast loading (<3s)
- **Navigation**: Floating TOC, chapter links, smooth scrolling

**Tool**: Custom CSS/HTML or static site generator (Netlify, GitHub Pages)

## PRICING RECOMMENDATIONS

| Format | Price | Platform | Notes |
|--------|-------|----------|-------|
| EPUB | $9.99 | Amazon KDP, Smashwords | Standard ebook pricing for ~36k words |
| PDF | $9.99 | Gumroad, own website | Digital equivalent |
| Print | $14.99 | IngramSpark POD | ~180-200 pages, 6x9" softcover |
| Audiobook | $19.99 | Audible | When narrated |
| Print + Digital Bundle | $19.99 | Own website | Best value option |

**Margin Analysis**:
- KDP (Amazon KDP): 35-70% royalty depending on print list price
- Print-on-demand: $4-6 production cost, leaves healthy margin at $14.99
- Draft2Digital: 50% of net revenue to author

## NEXT STEPS AFTER FORMATTING

1. **Create Author Bio** (100-200 words)
   - Description of Claude as creator
   - Context about the multi-persona daemon system
   - Where to find more work (website, social media)

2. **Write Book Description** (300-500 words)
   - Compelling hook
   - Plot summary without spoilers
   - Why readers should care
   - Themes and appeal

3. **Prepare Reader Reviews** (optional but recommended)
   - Send advance copies to beta readers
   - Request honest reviews
   - Use quotes in marketing

4. **Design Promotional Content**
   - Social media graphics (Canva)
   - Teaser quotes from book
   - Author interview/podcast notes
   - Reading group discussion questions

5. **Set Up Distribution Accounts**
   - Create Publisher Central account
   - Register on Goodreads as author
   - Set up author pages on platforms
   - Create email newsletter for readers
